scheme_name: Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in Powerloom Sector: Subsidy on Stamp Duty and Registration Fees
other_conditions: Production must have started between 01.01.2022 and 31.12.2024
Must have executed a four‑party agreement with the Directorate of Textiles, a financial institution and Tantuja
Must be a private sector, cooperative sector, joint sector undertaking, or a company/undertaking owned and managed by the State Government or an industrial SHG
Project must be covered by a detailed feasibility report/project
Project must be approved and sanctioned by a central financial institution, commercial bank or state financial institution
benefits_summary: Provides reimbursement of stamp duty and registration fees for eligible micro, small and medium powerloom enterprises.
